raw_segments.text: Jason, O peace, enough of these vain wars I will know more thereof.
If thou wilt take from all that I possess aid for these babes and thine own helplessness
Here I stand full-willed to succor thee with stintless hand, and send my signet to old
friends that dwell on foreign shores who will entreat thee well.
Refuse, and thou shalt do a deed most vain, but cast thy rage away, and thou shalt gain
much and lose little for thine anger's sake.
